title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
**Company Description** **Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited** is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end\-to\-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 28,200\+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.

 **Job Description** **Essential Skills:**


Overall, 5 – 7 years of experience as Senior Technology Consultant (SAP Basis) with strong working experience on Upgrades \& Migrations and Production Support of SAP ABAP \& JAVA systems in Hybrid Environment.

**Minimum 3 – 4 years of SAP Upgrade and Migration Experience required as below.**

* Should have Strong work experience in DESIGN, SIZE, BUILD \& RUN of SAP Intelligent Suite Systems on Hybrid Environments (IaaS \& PaaS)
* Collaborate with Functional Experts to understand Business Requirements and provide Technical Solutions
* Minimum Two Projects with End\-to\-End Planning, Preparation \& Execution of Implementation, Migration of SAP ERP / S/4HANA Systems
* Minimum One End\-to\-End Cycle of OS/DB/ Hardware Migrations using SUM, DMO \& HSR Methods in Hybrid Environments
* Minimum Two End to End Upgrades like EHP, S/4HANA and SPS.
* Minimum One End to End Cycle of S/4 HANA / BW4HANA Conversion
* Work experience with Integration of SAP CPI and BTP Products

 **Minimum 2 – 3 years of SAP Basis Production Support Experience as below**

* Should be able to technically manage Mission Critical 24/7 Production landscapes.
* Should be having Strong experience in administration of ECC, S4HANA, BW4HANA, SAP PO Systems.
* Strong knowledge of Database Administration in SAP HANA and Oracle, including Performance tuning
* Working knowledge in SAP Security Hardening and Performance tuning of SAP Systems
* Experience in System Copy, System refresh and DB Refreshes
* Experience in SAP System Backup \& Restore process for Linux systems.
* Expertise in Design, Implement and manage Business Continuity Solutions such as Clustering, HA / DR Failover Solutions for SAP landscapes.
* Hands on experience on Linux \& AIX operating system at administration level

**Soft skills:**

* Communication and Presentation skills to play customer facing roles.
* Strong communication skills to lead and drive topics independently.
* Flexible to adapt with the Project schedules and demands.
* Good to have ability to demonstrate as cross functional and ability to work in a collaborative team environment.

**SAP Certifications as Added Advantage (if Any):**

* SAP S/4 HANA Conversion and Upgrade
* SAP OS/DB Migration Certified
* SAP S/4 HANA Administration
* Any Public cloud Certifications preferably SAP Specialized like **SAP on AWS**, **SAP Workloads in Azure** etc.

 **Qualifications** **Educational qualification:**

* BE, BTech, BCA, BSc (IT) MCA, MBA (IT) and MSc(IT)

**Experience :**

* 5 \- 7 Years of experience
